author: The Q
description:
Can changing the light around your TV actually make movies and games feel more immersive? Instead of relying on marketing claims, I ran four different experiments to find out what really makes a great home theater experience.

From comparing a basic LED strip against a synchronized backlight, to testing fast-paced action scenes and even a triple-monitor racing simulator, the goal was simple: see what actually makes a difference.
